background: Cinematic graphics default to moving footage with the cinematic blur treatment behind sharp foreground components. Use raw footage, paper, or a solid surface when deliberately chosen for another presentation.
map_rules: same projection and scale for comparison
geographic coordinates drive all markers and paths
dated source needed for historical boundaries
uncertain boundaries use a distinct dashed encoding
route drawing time does not assert travel duration
forbidden: source corner labels in published episodes

diagram_information_safe.note: Coordinate bounds reserve space at the bottom for Chinese captions. Full-frame images and decorative backgrounds are exempt.
